scope: A node-tree check in the collision loader and the three renderers' world loaders, decided on and proven against every map of every installed game: an offline measurement of every tree, a load of every map before and after the change in each renderer, and the damaged maps of the index-check record again with three tree variants added, run before and after the change.

refuses: a child that is its own node or a node above it (cycle)
a child already reached below another node (shared)
a path through more than 2048 nodes (tooDeep)
a child outside the node or leaf table (outside; the index checks refuse it first)
leavesAlone: the order the nodes are numbered in
callers: CMod_LoadNodes, after every child is checked
R_LoadNodesAndLeafs in each renderer, before R_SetParent
rule.memory: a path of at most 2048 steps and a bit a node, in scratch from the temporary hunk, released before any refusal

audit.lastChangedBy: the commit that adds this record

installations.fakk2: .tmp/fakk2-install/game (laid down from the retail disc copy at E:\Games\Heavy Metal FAKK2)
installations.q3test: .tmp/q3test/install (one folder per release, laid down from the six Win32 packages)

environment: Windowed on unswitched private desktops (tests/windows_private_process.py), one fresh process and isolated fs_homepath per load, empty configurations under every profile name in the home, sound and mouse/joystick input disabled, Steam integration and the WebUI off, networking off, console commands only. Retail installations were read, never written.

audit.treesFormat: [depth, nodes, leafs no node names, models]; depth counts the nodes on the longest path from node 0 to a leaf
audit.note: every map of every installation as the loaders present it, through the engine's own translators; the loaders' walk is BSP_NodeTreeFault compiled from the committed header

stack.basis: S_FRAMEPROC frame size plus callee-saved registers, return address and pushed arguments, from the before build's program databases (llvm-pdbutil); CM_PointLeafnum_r and R_PointInLeaf loop rather than recurse, and R_MarkLeaves walks up the parents R_SetParent set

loads.mapsFormat: [outcome, first engine error or null, the faces, meshes, triangle surfaces and flares the renderers counted or null, the renderers whose sweeps ran it]; every sweep that ran a map gave these values, before the change and after it
